facts.label: reported
facts.quote: India's core sector output growth for September recorded a remarkable 7.9%, driven largely by expansion in coal and electricity.
facts.text: India's core sector output expanded by 7.9% year-on-year in September, marking a new series high.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Coal production saw a sharp rebound with a growth rate of 10.7% following previous negative trends.
facts.text: Coal output registered a sharp rebound with an expansion rate of 10.7% in September.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Electricity generation growth moderated to 11.4% in September from 13.1% in August.
facts.text: Electricity generation growth eased to 11.4% in September compared to the preceding month.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Steel output grew 4.9%, the fastest pace in three months, compared with 3.5% in August.
facts.text: Steel production climbed to a three-month peak growth rate of 4.9% during September.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: Cement production rose 9.8%, lower than 11.7% in the month before.
facts.text: Cement manufacturing grew by 9.8% year-on-year in September.

facts.label: reported

script.hook: Raat ke 9 baje, TV pe khabar aayi: core sector 7.9 percent badha.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: A middle-class Indian living room at night, an old TV glowing with a news bulletin showing rising factory chimneys and power lines, PAPA in a kurta on the sofa leaning forward with interest, warm yellow lamp light

scenes.vo: Raat ke 9 baje, TV pe khabar aayi: core sector 7.9 percent badha.

scenes.label: SETUP

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta placing a steel chai cup on a side table, smiling confidently, MUMMY in a saree standing beside him holding a tray, a drawn thought bubble above showing a coal mine, a power plant, steel rods and cement bags, evening

scenes.vo: Core sector yaani desh ki bunyadi industries, jaise coal, bijli, steel, cement. Papa ne chai ka cup rakha, aur bole, ab sab sasta hoga.

scenes.label: CHOICE

visual.prompt: PAPA gesturing with both hands like explaining a simple rule, a drawn picture beside him of a big pile of goods next to a falling price tag arrow, cosy living room, night

scenes.vo: Unka logic bilkul seedha aur saaf tha. Zyada maal banega, toh dukaan pe daam girega.

scenes.label: CHOICE

visual.prompt: BHAI in a hoodie sprawled on the sofa, grinning at his phone, imagining a petrol pump meter running cheap, excited expression, night living room

scenes.vo: BHAI ne turant phone uthaya. Bola, petrol bhi ab sasta hi milega.

scenes.label: CHOICE

visual.prompt: A nostalgic drawn panel of a school classroom blackboard showing a simple supply and demand cross diagram, a young boy nodding at his desk, soft daylight, no text

scenes.vo: Sunne mein baat sahi lagti hai. Supply badhe, toh keemat ghate, yahi toh school mein padha tha.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: The TV screen close-up split in two halves: one side a busy coal mine and bright power station, the other side an idle oil rig and a quiet gas pipeline under grey sky, family in the background not paying attention, night

scenes.vo: Par khabar ka doosra hissa kisi ne nahi suna. Coal aur bijli badhe, par desh ka crude aur gas production gira.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: A huge oil tanker ship arriving at an Indian port at dusk, cranes and pipelines carrying oil towards a city skyline, dramatic orange sky, sense of dependence

scenes.vo: Crude yaani kachcha tel, jisse petrol aur diesel bante hain. Bharat apna lagbhag 88 percent crude bahar se mangata hai.

scenes.label: WHAT REALLY HAPPENED

visual.prompt: A young man at a petrol pump looking up at the price meter with a frown, behind him a drawn globe with ships and oil barrels floating around it, late evening light

scenes.vo: Matlab petrol ka daam hamare coal se nahi, duniya ke bazaar se tay hota hai.

scenes.label: THE TWIST

visual.prompt: SG in a striped shirt sitting with PAPA and BHAI at the dining table, calmly explaining, a drawn panel behind showing workers entering a busy factory gate at sunrise, PAPA thoughtful

scenes.vo: Growth ka matlab factory mein kaam aur naukri hai, har cheez sasta hona zaroori nahi.

scenes.label: WHAT YOU CAN DO

visual.prompt: WIFE at the kitchen table holding a monthly grocery and fuel bill, comparing it with a newspaper, sharp curious look, morning light through the window

scenes.vo: Agli baar headline suno, toh poochho: kaun si cheez badhi, aur meri jeb ki kaun si? Yeh investment advice nahi hai.

scenes.label: END QUESTION

visual.prompt: The whole family, PAPA, MUMMY, BHAI and WIFE, around the dining table with chai, everyone looking at each other wondering, warm evening glow

scenes.vo: Aapke ghar mein sabse zyada kharcha kis cheez pe badha hai? Comment mein ek shabd likho.

topic.summary: India's core sector output growth for September recorded a remarkable 7.9%, driven largely by expansion in coal and electricity. Notably, refinery products and iron ore also contributed to this growth, supported by a favorable base effect. Coal production saw a sharp rebound with a growth rate of 10.7% following previous negative trends. Electricity generation growth declined slightly, impacted by heatwave conditions in the country.
topic.title: Core output grows at series high of 7.9% in Sept
